note: USACE Saylorville Lake campground (Rock Island District) on more than 60 acres north of Des Moines, with over 40 acres of prairie plantings, a swimming beach, playgrounds, group shelters and educational programs; the visitor center, disc golf, boat ramps and the paved Neal Smith Trail are nearby. Sites on the south end look out over the lake. --Claude
summary: Electric 50, 153 sites confirmed; max rig 85 and pull-through added; facilities confirmed; booking: reservations required (fcfs never) and 14-night limit added. Lakeview stands (site photos). Fees left (rate table matches 22-28).
flags: LAKEVIEW STANDS: the USACE description says 'Many of the family sites in the south end offer a pleasant view of the 6000-acre lake', and the rec.gov preview photos show the lake past prairie grass and trees from C82, C85, C87, C89, C90, C92, C94 and C95 (C83 shows none). On-water candidates: 0. The nearest pads (C-loop west edge, ~41.741,-93.6905) sit ~300-370 m from the shore across a prairie slope, woods and the beach/parking area.
SEASON: the 2026/2027 rate table runs Peak Season May 1 - Oct 24 only; the description gives no opening dates, so no season written.
PIN: stored 41.7466,-93.6872 is on the main road between the A and B loops; the 153 site coordinates average 41.7447,-93.6895 (~280 m SW). Suggest 41.7447,-93.6895.
